items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: White and Black would line up there... they had to listen to me and Jenny. It was just piano and vocal.

ctx.x: White and Black would line up there after work because they had a very good chef there and they would come there to eat and then they had to listen to me and Jenny. It was just piano and vocal. And of course I sang at tables then. The club had eight tables in it. I think that was the first club that I could stand in the middle of the floor and sing and everybody could hear me. But that was my first BIG opportunity, I mean, I really said, well, I'm really in now. Because I saved my money and the next step is New…
